title: selected_chat index not reset when chat list shrinks
description: event.rs load_startup_data clamps selected_chat to chat_list.len()-1 when the list is non-empty (line 275). However handle_state_change type 'Chat' calls load_startup_data which may return a shorter list than before (e.g. a contact is removed). If selected_chat was pointing to index 3 and the list shrinks to 2 items it will be clamped to 1. That is correct. But the prev_selected in run() is NOT updated when load_startup_data runs via handle_state_change, so after the clamping, prev_selected \!= state.selected_chat and run() will immediately attempt to reload messages for the newly selected chat. This is benign but causes an extra unnecessary message reload on every Chat state change.
